item.title: A message to send a friend today
item.summary: One small text that can make a friend's day better.

sections.heading: Send one message
paragraphs: Pick one friend you have not spoken to lately and send them a short message today.
It does not need to be long. A simple hello is enough.

sections.heading: Keep it simple
paragraphs: Say you were thinking of them and ask how they are.

body.takeaway: One message to a friend can make a day better.
